import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Prepare data for visualization
# Fill missing 'age' values with the median age for more complete plotting
df['age'].fillna(df['age'].median(), inplace=True)
# Map numeric pclass to descriptive strings for facet titles
df['class_str'] = df['pclass'].map({1: '1st Class', 2: '2nd Class', 3: '3rd Class'})

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Titanic Survival Factors', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Survival Rate by Class and Sex ---
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    ax=ax1,
    palette={'male': '#3498db', 'female': '#e74c3c'},
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third']
)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))
ax1.legend(title='Sex')
for p in ax1.patches:
    ax1.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
                   (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                   ha='center', va='center',
                   xytext=(0, 9),
                   textcoords='offset points')

# --- Plot 2: Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors ---
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='age',
    hue='alive',
    fill=True,
    common_norm=False,
    ax=ax2,
    palette={'no': '#d9534f', 'yes': '#5cb85c'}
)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Survived', labels=['Yes', 'No'])

# --- Plot 3: Survival Rate by Family Size ---
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
sns.lineplot(
    data=df,
    x='family_size',
    y='survived',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    marker='o',
    color='purple',
    errorbar=('ci', 95)
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Total Family Size', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Number of Family Members (Siblings/Spouse + Parents/Children)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(df['family_size'].max() + 1))


# --- Plot 4: Fare vs. Age for Survivors, Faceted by Class ---
# Create a temporary dataframe to handle log scale for fare, avoiding log(0)
plot_df = df.copy()
plot_df['fare'] = plot_df['fare'].replace(0, 1) # Replace 0 fare with 1 to plot on log scale

ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.scatterplot(
    data=plot_df,
    x='age',
    y='fare',
    hue='alive',
    style='class_str',
    size='class_str',
    sizes=(120, 40),
    palette={'no': '#d9534f', 'yes': '#5cb85c'},
    ax=ax4,
    alpha=0.7
)
ax4.set_yscale('log')
ax4.set_title('Fare vs. Age by Survival and Class', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (Log Scale)', fontsize=12)
ax4.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.ScalarFormatter())
ax4.legend(title='Status & Class', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
